bizstream-grilling.name: Grilling Everywhere
bizstream-grilling.description: Wraps every question-asking command so it interviews the user in dependency-ordered rounds instead of ad hoc. The protocol is inlined in each wrap and reads after the wrapped command, so it beats the command's own question rules. Requires the grill extension.
bizstream-grilling.author: BizStream

bizstream-implement.name: Implement With Gates
bizstream-implement.description: Replaces speckit.implement: the constitution's gates, subagent workers with a review per phase, every definition-of-done row, acceptance verified, and a local review loop. Never pushes. Reads the card extension's config and code-repo template, so install card with it.
bizstream-implement.author: BizStream

bizstream-bugfix.name: Bug Fix With Gates
bizstream-bugfix.description: Wraps speckit.bug.fix so a fix runs the constitution's definition of done and the review loop of speckit.review.run before it is reported fixed. Requires the bug and review extensions.
bizstream-bugfix.author: BizStream
